referenceFunction.generalComment: Refers to 1 kg dry matter of fresh gras from intensive organic production with 1.66 kg CO2 and 17.9 MJ per kg dry matter. The dry matter content of fresh gras is about 10-15%; UUID: 9f6ebdd8-81eb-3cb6-a875-99af965b0633
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventories include the cultivation of gras on a temporary meadow. Included steps are soil cultivation, fertilisation (cattle slurry and manure), harvest, loading for transport.
referenceFunction.localName: xx Grass from meadow intensive, organic, at field
referenceFunction.name: xx Grass from meadow intensive, organic, at field

geography.text: Refers to a production in the Swiss plateau (lowlands <700m).

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data were compiled from statistics, fertilising recommendations, documents from extension services and expert knowledge.
